stem_book: Fill in the blank with appropriate term. (i) According to Le Chatelier's principle, if a dynamic equilibrium is disturbed by changing the conditions, the position of equilibrium moves to ______ the change. (ii) Le Chatelier's principle can be used to predict the effect of a change in ______ on the position of equilibrium. (iii) If a chemical system at equilibrium experiences a change in concentration, temperature, volume, or partial pressure, then the equilibrium will shift to ______ the change. (iv) In an exothermic reaction, an increase in temperature will shift the equilibrium to the ______ side. (v) According to Le Chatelier's principle, an increase in pressure will favor the side of the reaction that has the ______ number of moles of gas.
correct_answer: (i) counteract (ii) concentration, pressure or temperature (iii) counteract (iv) reactant (left) (v) smaller
reason: Quick-recap fill-in-the-blank with 5 parts and separate answers, no options; manifest lists the 5 parts under one duplicated code
work: Le Chatelier: shift opposes change; exothermic + heat -> backward; higher P -> fewer gas moles
